server.name: wazuh-siem
server.description: APTL Wazuh SIEM MCP Server - Provides AI agents with secure access to Wazuh SIEM operations in the APTL (Advanced Purple Team Lab) environment.

query_alerts.description: Search processed Wazuh alerts with filters. Use Elasticsearch query DSL in body parameter. Example: {"body": {"query": {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-1h"}}}}}

query_logs.description: Search raw log data (archives) before rule processing. Requires logall_json=yes in ossec.conf and the archives fileset enabled in the Filebeat wazuh module. Use Elasticsearch query DSL in body parameter. Example: {"body": {"query": {"match": {"data.srcip": "192.168.1.1"}}}}

create_detection_rule.description: Upload a custom Wazuh rules file through the authenticated rules-file API. Put the file name in params.filename and the complete rules XML in body as a raw string. The file name must end in .xml and contain only letters, digits, '_', '.' or '-'. Set params.overwrite to true to replace an existing file. Example: {"params": {"filename": "custom_rules.xml", "overwrite": true}, "body": "<group name=\"custom,\">...</group>"}
